verdict.rationale: Persona's docs mention 'database lookups' as an identity verification method and list document-free Reports (Address Lookup, Watchlist, PEP, Adverse Media) that verify against authoritative external data sources rather than a document scan. However, there is no explicit mention of SSN-specific verification, national ID registry checks, or credit-header/credit-bureau data as a distinct product capability. Missing for 10: explicit SSN verification method, named national registry integrations, credit-header data source, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of these document-free flows.
